author: KEXP
description: Hailing from the city of Cork, Irish five-piece Cardinals explode with an impassioned and transfixing rock sound. Our latest in-studio session invites them in to share a sharp performance of "St. Agnes" and more.
title: Cardinals performs "St. Agnes" & more Live on KEXP
